title: Electric Vehicle Charging Technology: Urban Electric - Pop-Up Charger | Fully Charged
summary: A Fully Charged episode where Robert Llewellyn visits an Oxford street trialling Urban Electric's pop-up chargers. These are retractable 7kW charging points built into street furniture for homes without off-street parking.
why: HN commenters bring it up in EV-adoption threads as an answer to how people without driveways can charge on the street.

quote.text: Pop-up chargers are at least hidden when not in use
